key_insight: VISTA Architect precomputes a provenance-linked clinical knowledge graph and timeline so LLMs can answer patient-history questions faster and more accurately than repeated raw-text prompting or RAG.
clinical_relevance: For tumor boards, this could make complex longitudinal EHR review more reliable and efficient while preserving traceability back to source documentation.
method: Builds a source-faithful MEDS Graph that retains granular EHR structure and provenance
Creates a Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that uses graph-guided LLM extraction to deduplicate and order clinical events
Supports downstream querying through an organized patient state with optional drill-down to original records
evidence_signal: In 1,180 thoracic oncology patients, the system reached 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) across 15 tumor-board variables over 17,700 evaluations.
watch_item: Results come from thoracic oncology at one center, so broader validation and specialty-specific adaptation are still needed before wider deployment.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
